analysis: The only change in this file is at line 312 of EngineV2ProductionWiringTests.swift. A test helper's switch now handles `.toolCall, .toolCallDelta` together with `continue`, so the new `toolCallDelta` enum case no longer breaks exhaustiveness. This is test-only code. It adds no production attack surface, no trust-boundary change, and no change to authorization, attestation, encryption or billing. The supplied units (base lines 1221-2472) contain no edited lines. They cover existing tests for heartbeat capacity re-slicing, tool_choice fail-closed validation, forged schema metadata rejection, media bypass of the bridge, cancellation propagation, cacheSalt plumbing (T-041 / TB-007), KV fallback reason clamping, and prefill-deadline config. All of these are unchanged context. One caveat is that the new `.toolCallDelta` event is introduced in production code outside this batch. The next pass should check that the streaming path cannot emit tool-call deltas before fail-closed forced-tool-choice validation. The existing tests assert `emitted.isEmpty` when validation fails, but this helper now skips deltas, so those assertions would not see deltas that the helper ignores. That is a test-coverage question, not a vulnerability proven by this diff. No threat-model assumptions are invalidated by the supplied evidence.
